title: MasterMix Solo #31 (일반 신발 · 솔로 · 금박 emerald green · 앵글 하이앵글 70도 · 조명 fire · 시간대 없음 · 분위기 cyberpunk glamour · 체형 pregnant colossal · 인종 ebony · 헤어 a voluminous natural afro · 메이크업 와인 레드립 극한 · 배경 오페라 하우스 계단 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 20s goddess, pregnant colossal physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy; a colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface; enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms; her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, a voluminous natural afro in jet-black — full body applied EMERALD GREEN metallic leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING EMERALD GREEN leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams laid onto the contour of her body, a bright EMERALD GREEN sheen filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: both arms raised overhead — most extreme pregnant colossal silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, extreme chunky platform sandals in solid sage green satin-finish leather, each with a very thick monolithic chunky sole with a thick strap-covered platform, a natural relaxed stance with her weight settled on her feet.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, round nails each as long as her forearm is wide, covered in the same EMERALD GREEN metallic leaf with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT gilded — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick saturated near-black burgundy lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, deep plum-brown smoky eyes, dramatic lashes.

Background: the grand marble staircase of an opera house with standard-height steps, a waist-high carved balustrade, chandeliers and warm daylight from tall windows, firelight, warm flickering flames, dramatic orange glow, cyberpunk glamour mood, futuristic neon atmosphere, dystopian editorial, every person's whole figure from the shoes to the top of her head clearly lit and fully visible with every material detail sharp, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length steep high-angle shot taken from far above with a long telephoto lens, the camera directly above and in front of her angled roughly seventy degrees downward as if from a high ceiling or drone, flat telephoto compression with natural proportions and no wide-angle distortion, the whole figure from head to boots fully visible, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering soles clearly lifting her far above the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
